summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by STRATS Trust for Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities, Series 2005-1, reporting a scheduled distribution to certificate holders on April 15, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, no corporate action, and no event that qualifies as a special situation. It is purely a periodic distribution update with attached trustee statement. No terms, recommendation, or deal mechanics are present. This is a standard current report for a structured finance trust with no special-situation relevance.
